arxiv-2102-00373.title: Construction of explicit symplectic integrators in general relativity. I. Schwarzschild black holes
arxiv-2102-00373.creator: Ying Wang 1,2 , Wei Sun 1 , Fuyao Liu 1 , Xin Wu 1,2,3,†
arxiv-2102-00373.description: Abstract Symplectic integrators that preserve the geometric structure of Hamiltonian flows and do not exhibit secular growth in energy errors are suitable for the long-term integration of N-body Hamiltonian systems in the solar system. However, the construction of explicit symplectic integrators is frequently difficult in general relativity because all variables are inseparable.

arxiv-2109-07542.title: Text as Causal Mediators: Research Design for Causal Estimates of Differential Treatment of Social Groups via Language Aspects
arxiv-2109-07542.creator: Katherine A. Keith, Douglas Rice, Brendan O’Connor
arxiv-2109-07542.description: Abstract Using observed language to understand interpersonal interactions is important in high-stakes decision making. We propose a causal research design for observational (non-experimental) data to estimate the natural direct and indirect effects of social group signals (e.g. race or gender) on speakers’ responses with separate aspects of language as causal mediators.

arxiv-2203-02926.title: Generic symmetry defect set of an algebraic curve
arxiv-2203-02926.creator: L.R.G. Dias & M. Farnik & Z. Jelonek
arxiv-2203-02926.description: Abstract . Let X ⊂ ℂ 2 ​ n X\subset\mathbb{C}^{2n} be an n n -dimensional algebraic variety. We define the algebraic version of the generic symmetry defect set (Wigner caustic) of X X . Moreover, we compute its singularities for X d X_{d} being a generic curve of degree d d in ℂ 2 \mathbb{C}^{2} .

arxiv-2204-11363.title: Survey on the metric SYZ conjecture and non-archimedean geometry
arxiv-2204-11363.creator: Yang Li
arxiv-2204-11363.description: Abstract We survey the metric aspects of the Strominger-Yau-Zaslow conjecture on the existence of special Lagrangian fibrations on Calabi-Yau manifolds near the large complex structure limit. We will discuss the diverse motivations for the conjectural picture, what the best hopes are, and a number of subtleties.

arxiv-2206-04994.title: Neutrinos, mixed bosons, Quantum Reference Frames and entanglement
arxiv-2206-04994.creator: A. Capolupo, A. Quaranta
arxiv-2206-04994.description: Abstract We discuss the relevance of quantum reference frames in the description of mixed particle states. We show that the notion of rest frame for mixed particles, which is classically ill-defined, can be introduced in the context of quantum frames. We discuss the possible phenomenological implications, displaying a new form of frame-dependent entanglement that characterizes reactions involving mixed particles.

arxiv-2304-09819.title: Old and new motivic cycles on Abelian surfaces
arxiv-2304-09819.creator: Ramesh Sreekantan
arxiv-2304-09819.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ramesh Sreekantan. Collino [ Col02 ] discovered indecomposable motivic cycles in the group H ℳ 2 ​ g − 1 ​ ( J ⁡ ( C ) , ℤ ⁡ ( g ) ) H^{2g-1}_{{\mathcal{M}}}(J(C),{\mathds{Z}}(g)) . In [ Sre22 ] we described the construction of some new motivic cycles which can be viewed as a generalization of Collino’s cycle when g = 2 g=2 . In this paper we show that our new cycles are in fact related to Collino’s cycles of higher genus.

arxiv-2308-15555.title: Three-dimensional 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{P}\mathcal{T} -symmetric topological phases with a Pontryagin index
arxiv-2308-15555.creator: Zory Davoyan, Wojciech J. Jankowski, Adrien Bouhon, Robert-Jan Slager
arxiv-2308-15555.description: Abstract We report on a certain class of three-dimensional topological insulators and semimetals protected by spinless 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{P}\mathcal{T} symmetry, hosting an integer-valued bulk invariant. We show using homotopy arguments that these phases host multigap topology, providing a realization of a single ℤ \mathbb{Z} invariant in three spatial dimensions that is distinct from the Hopf index.

arxiv-2402-10373.title: BioMistral: A Collection of Open-Source Pretrained Large Language Models for Medical Domains
arxiv-2402-10373.creator: Yanis Labrak Adrien Bazoge, Emmanuel Morin Pierre-Antoine Gourraud Mickael Rouvier Richard Dufour
arxiv-2402-10373.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable versatility in recent years, offering potential applications across specialized domains such as healthcare and medicine. Despite the availability of various open-source LLMs tailored for health contexts, adapting general-purpose LLMs to the medical domain presents significant challenges.

arxiv-2405-17788.title: Enhancing Road Safety: Real-Time Detection of Driver Distraction through Convolutional Neural Networks
arxiv-2405-17788.creator: Amaan Aijaz Sheikh, Imaad Zaffar Khan
arxiv-2405-17788.description: Abstract As we navigate our daily commutes, the threat posed by a distracted driver is at a large, resulting in a troubling rise in traffic accidents. Addressing this safety concern, our project harnesses the analytical power of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), with a particular emphasis on the well-established models VGG16 and VGG19.

arxiv-2406-18816.title: Angle-dependent planar thermal Hall effect by quasi-ballistic phonons in black phosphorus
arxiv-2406-18816.creator: Xiaokang Li, Xiaodong Guo, Zengwei Zhu, Kamran Behnia
arxiv-2406-18816.description: Abstract The origin of the phonon thermal Hall effect in insulators is a matter of ongoing debate. The large amplitude of the signal in an elemental non-magnetic solid, such as black phosphorus (BP), calls for a minimal mechanism not invoking the spin degree of freedom.

arxiv-2407-00593.title: A proposal of quasi-local mass for 2 2 -surfaces of timelike mean curvature
arxiv-2407-00593.creator: Bowen Zhao, Shing-Tung Yau, Lars Andersson
arxiv-2407-00593.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Bowen Zhao, Shing-Tung Yau, Lars Andersson. A quasi-local mass, typically defined as an integral over a spacelike 2 2 -surface Σ \Sigma , should encode information about the gravitational field within a finite, extended region bounded by Σ \Sigma . Therefore, in attempts to quantize gravity, one may consider an infinite dimensional space of 2 2 -surfaces instead of an infinite dimensional space of 4 4 -dimensional Lorentzian spacetimes.

arxiv-2601-04373.title: Dialect Matters: Cross-Lingual ASR Transfer for Low-Resource Indic Language Varieties
arxiv-2601-04373.creator: Akriti Dhasmana, Aarohi Srivastava, David Chiang
arxiv-2601-04373.description: Abstract We conduct an empirical study of cross-lingual transfer using spontaneous, noisy, and code-mixed speech across a wide range of Indic dialects and language varieties. Our results indicate that although ASR performance is generally improved with reduced phylogenetic distance between languages, this factor alone does not fully explain performance in dialectal settings.

europmc-pmc7323555.description: During January 26-February 10, 2020, an outbreak of 2019 novel coronavirus disease in an air-conditioned restaurant in Guangzhou, China, involved 3 family clusters. The airflow direction was consistent with droplet transmission. To prevent the spread of the virus in restaurants,

pmc-11606209.title: Agile monitoring dashboard for clinical research studies
pmc-11606209.creator: Leslie Gardner, Peggy Bylund, Sarah Robbins, Emma Holler, Fereshtehossadat Shojaei, Fatemehalsadat Shojaei, Mark Seidman, Richard J. Holden, Nicole R. Fowler, Ben Zarzaur, Cristina Barboi, Malaz Boustani
pmc-11606209.description: BackgroundClinical trial success hinges on efficient participant recruitment and retention. However, slow accrual and attrition frequently hinder progress. To address these challenges, a novel dashboard tool with control charts has been developed to provide investigators on the multi-site study of Delirium and Neuropsychological Recovery among Emergency General Surgery Survivors (DANE study) with timely information to improve trial recruitment.

pmc-11772348.title: Characterization and application of fluorescent hydrogel films with superior mechanical properties in detecting iron(Ⅲ) ions and ferroptosis in oral cancer
pmc-11772348.creator: Jinxi Wen, Jian Wang, Siqi Wang, Xingping Zhou, You Fu
pmc-11772348.description: A one-step hydrothermal method was applied to prepare carbon dots (CDs) with superior fluorescence properties using chitosan as a carbon source. The as-prepared carbon dots were then grafted onto a sodium alginate-gelatin hydrogel film to form a fluorescent hydrogel film (FHGF), emitting at 450 nm under excitation of 350 nm light.

pmc-12423551.title: Advantages and Limitations of ChatGPT in Healthcare: A Scoping Review
pmc-12423551.creator: Seyyede Fateme Ghasemi, Parastoo Amiri, Zahra Galavi
pmc-12423551.description: Background and AimsChatGPT, an AI language model developed by OpenAI, has emerged as a transformative tool in the healthcare sector. Its ability to process vast amounts of medical data and generate human‐like responses offers significant potential for enhancing patient engagement and supporting healthcare professionals. However, despite its advantages, there are significant limitations.

pmc-12576819.title: Recovery of High-Voltage Oxygen Redox Activity by Eliminating Residual Oxygen Dimers
pmc-12576819.creator: Youngsin Kim, Hyuk-Joon Kim, Dae Soo Jung, Okkyun Seo, Akhil Tayal, Hojoon Lim, Saki Imada, Jooha Park, Sung-Pyo Cho, Youngjun Jeon, Jihyeon Kim, Donggun Eum, Seongmin Kang, Byungwook Kang, Kyoungoh Kim, Hongjin Ahn, Jonghun Park, Ho-Young Jang, Sung-O Park, Joohyeon Noh, Chaelin Lee, Jong Deok Lee,
pmc-12576819.description: Oxygen-redox layered oxides are promising electrode materials with the potential for superior energy density; however, their real-world employment is hindered by severe electrochemical irreversibility. The fundamental origin of this irreversibility has been difficult to pinpoint due to the complex evolution of both the structure and redox centers during cycling.

pmc-12751469.title: Antimicrobial resistance and stewardship in a dental curriculum in South Africa: a single-site curriculum mapping study
pmc-12751469.creator: Suwayda Ahmed, RZ Adam, R Coetzee, RD Maart
pmc-12751469.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial resistance (AMR) currently poses a significant public health crisis. Shortcomings in the knowledge and awareness of AMR and antimicrobial stewardship (AMS) among dental practitioners and undergraduate dental students have been widely reported, highlighting the need for comprehensive education and training programs to address AMR and AMS in curricula.

pmc-13412428.title: Endothelial Senescence-Associated Secretory Signaling Promotes Macrophage Extracellular Traps Formation and Contributes to the Exacerbation of Combined Lung Injury
pmc-13412428.creator: Wentao Xie, Hongsen Liao, Yali Dai, Lin Chen, Yujie Li, Zhuo Cheng, Chunmeng Shi
pmc-13412428.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Radiation-induced lung injury (RILI) is a common complication of thoracic radiotherapy and can be critically exacerbated by pre-existing pulmonary inflammation, yet the synergistic mechanisms driving this pathology remain elusive. Using a murine model of combined lung injury induced by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) and thoracic irradiation (IR), we identified macrophage extracellular traps (METs), a type of web-like chromatin structure released by macrophages, rather than neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), as a prominent pathogenic process.

pmc-13451726.title: Efficacy and Safety of Sintilimab in Combination With Anlotinib and Chemoradiotherapy as First-Line Treatment for Driver Gene-Negative Oligometastatic Non-small Cell Lung Cancer: A Real-World Cohort Study
pmc-13451726.creator: Jian Jiang, Chen Ni, Chunfeng Wu, Yu Song, Huiping Zhu
pmc-13451726.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of sintilimab combined with anlotinib and chemoradiotherapy as first-line treatment for driver gene-negative oligometastatic non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC).MethodsThis retrospective study included patients with driver gene-negative oligometastatic NSCLC (single organ, ≤2 lesions) treated at the Affiliated Zhangjiagang Hospital of Soochow University (7/2021–12/2023).

pmc-13593604.title: Gene action, combining ability, heterotic grouping and hybrid performance of tropical maize inbred lines from a public breeding program in Brazil
pmc-13593604.creator: Gabriela dos Santos Pereira, Victória Manhago Salvador, Yuri Mike Pontes Belo Lança, Rhai Christy Alves Silva, Mateus Feliciano Bicalho, Letícia Prada de Miranda, Rodrigo Oliveira DeLima
pmc-13593604.description: IntroductionSingle-cross hybrids are the predominant type of cultivar planted by maize growers worldwide. The clear understanding of both the inheritance of target traits and the heterotic patterns of breeding germplasm is essential for the development of heterotic and high-yielding single-cross hybrids in maize breeding programs.
